title: Cross-Layer Censorship Event Database
description: A working event corpus for two linked research arms: domain analysis of cross-layer crypto restrictions and recovery, and measurement analysis of coverage, source support, and coding error. Records link public triggers, targets, six observation surfaces, and source anchors. Existing admission and reaction labels are provisional legacy coding, including a separately marked secondary-evidence tier; hashes establish source integrity rather than semantic truth. Independent human validation and a bounded measurement cohort remain pending. Data/documentation use CC-BY-4.0; software uses MIT. Current working registry: 420 event records: 398 admitted, 6 draft, 16 rejected.
